body_html:
Stories of rock and roll and sobriety. Aerosmith used to practice in New London before tours. Not only is Steven Tyler sober but it is a dry set. Like lose your job immediately dry. Give band credit.

And Trey yeah the time of hiatus quite dark. Almost as if the devil had to be played for the dark funk he allowed to flow in the late 90s.
